richiami.difetto: The vehicle is equipped with additional electrically operated equipment which can result in the standard vehicle battery being subjected to high consumption due to the constant charging and discharging. It is therefore possible that after a number of years the condition of the battery can deteriorate to such an extent that an internal failure could result in the battery exploding.
richiami.modello: Heavy Duty Battery , Heavy Duty Battery
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicle and replace the standard vehicle battery with heavy duty high amperage deep cycle AGM battery.
